comment: Minigame scenes the Continue path reaches slowly or not at all.  Base: an album crafted with checkpoints.craft (the typical profile at the date, plus `set`), loaded by the title's Continue.  Hand-built fields cite the C they were read from.  ret_step/ret_sub_step/ret_sub_sub_step is the return triple each caller writes before its goto_step (the calling step); here the planner the defined point sits on, 52/1/0, as master_basyo_serifu_main writes for TACO.

fields.name: now_girl:1
fields.why: rpg_bat_init.c latches now_girl into D_8015EC18/D_8015EB9C; date_step129_goto.c sets now_girl = girl_no (Yuina, girl 2, the robot battles)

fields.name: ret_step:1
fields.why: geko_goto_step81.c / shugaku_step81_goto.c: ret_* = the calling step before goto_step(129); rpg_bat_exit returns through it

fields.name: rpg_bat_arg:4
fields.why: rpg_bat_init.c: switch (rpg_bat_arg) 1..7 picks the battle (D_8015EB98); shugaku_step81_goto.c sets 1..3

covers: RPG_BAT 129: the seven battles of rpg_bat_init's rpg_bat_arg switch, random input

fields.name: ret_step:1
fields.why: en_nichi_main2.c: goto_step(ret_step[0]), goto_sub_step(ret_step[1]), goto_sub_sub_step(ret_step[2]) at the end

fields.name: now_girl:1
fields.why: date_basyo18_step130_goto.c: the date's girl (the shrine, place 18) is now_girl

covers: EN_NICHI 130: the festival stall game, entered as from the shrine date, random input

fields.name: ret_step:1
fields.why: game_main case 208 -> func_80079628 runs TT.EXN synchronously and returns to D_800EEE80..82

covers: TT 208: the TT game, random input (booth 3 of BUNKAKEN enters it in the suite)
TACO 144: title, game and exit, random input

starts.comment: From TACO's attract flight: Start to the title (sub-step 2), Start to the menu (3), Up twice (taco_select_step wraps 0 -> 4 -> 3, OPERATIONS) and Circle.  Sub-sub-step 0 (taco_cd_image_load) decodes 3D_1.BS; 1 and 2 (taco_main7_main1 / main2) scroll the two TACOTEX pages while the narration plays XA entries 0..2 and 3..9 of D_8015F450; 3 (taco_cmd_advance) goes back to the title.  Shots: page 1 every 60 frames, page 2 every 80 (the scroll moves a line every 2 frames, then every 4).
covers: TACO 144/7: the OPERATIONS screen (3D_1.BS backdrop, both TACOTEX tutorial pages with their XA narration, back to the title), shot every 40..80 frames on both machines
TAIIKU 114: the sports festival entered directly (schedule_day_main case 32), random input
